createLocalHttpServer.note: Stage 7A slice 5 (2026-09-03): the loopback, read-only local HTTP server over the operation registry — one OperationError shape for every failure, X-Request-Id on every response; jobs and artifacts attach through the injected runner and store

statusForError.note: Stage 7A slice 5 (2026-09-03): the HTTP status an OperationError maps to (404 unknown · 413 too large · 400 input.* · 409 cancelled · 500 internal · 422 otherwise) — published so the guide and the server agree
